note: Journal of the Polynesian Society vols. 1-33 (1892-1924), issue #6768. One scan per volume from the Internet Archive periodicals series (collection pub_journal-of-the-polynesian-society, UIC copies), not access-restricted. Holdings-checked 2026-10-15: no volume held. The journal printed most transcribed Maori and Polynesian chants with translations, often in Maori (or Hawaiian, Tahitian, Rarotongan) with English. Vols. 34-39 (1925-30) are not in this IA series.
